mathematical_contract.domain_exactness: All four stream arguments are arbitrary real numbers.
mathematical_contract.convexity: Each head is convex on all of R^4, as a sum of squares of linear forms with coefficient 1/2.
mathematical_contract.nonnegativity: Each head is nonnegative on all of R^4.
mathematical_contract.monotonicity: The pair is coordinatewise monotone on the nonnegative orthant. No global monotonicity is claimed.
mathematical_contract.composition: Nonnegative convex incoming streams preserve convexity. Monotone nonnegative incoming streams preserve order on the stated set.
mathematical_contract.normalization: The difference of the two half-sums of squares is exactly (A-B)(C-D).
mathematical_contract.scope_limit: This primitive alone does not certify the complete Transformer computation graph.
